web_fixture.snippet: Default timeouts for the Lumen gateway.
web_fixture.content:
# Timeouts

The Lumen gateway ships with a default upstream timeout of 30 seconds. Idle client connections are closed after 75 seconds.

Long-running exports should use the async job API instead of raising the timeout.

# Lumen gateway rollout (internal)

Owner: platform team. Last reviewed 2026-08-02.

## Settings we run in production
- listener port: 8443
- upstream timeout: 45 seconds (raised after the billing-export incident)
- max request body: 16 MB
- retries: 2
